source: AF / AKATH SYSTEM BRIEF (2026-11-11) 'Platform risks' section + AR's own incident memory
rule: A risk is CLOSED only when a runnable check proves the mitigation is in place. A mitigation that is only prose is still OPEN.

risks.title: No cron / restart hook — a stopped sandbox never wakes itself
risks.mitigation: Run 24/7 work on GitHub Actions (always on, free for this public repo), not on the sandbox. The sandbox is transport only.
risks.evidence: the 6 scheduled workflows in .github/workflows/ (release, crosspost, dashboard, watchdog, roblox-live-state, token-heartbeat)

risks.title: Restart wipes the rootfs — /workspace and $HOME are lost
risks.mitigation: Durable state lives in the repo and the KV vault, never only on disk. Persistent runtime files (browser profile, pylibs, tools) sit under /workspace/ax-tools, which survives a recycle but not a new pod.

risks.title: The work host URL changes every restart (work-1 / work-2)
risks.mitigation: Build the operator URL at run time from RUNTIME_ID, never hardcode it.
risks.evidence: cloud-desktop bootstrap.py --url; ops/phone_login.py reads the session's work_hosts

risks.title: A new chat does not remember context
risks.mitigation: chat = transport, repo = authority. A fresh session reads .openhands/CHARTER.md + .openhands/memory/MEMORY.md and restores the vault before working.

risks.title: Automation-run quota (20/day) is shared across the whole account
risks.mitigation: Prefer deterministic GitHub Actions rails over OpenHands automation runs; keep the automation count low; a paused automation is auto-healed by the rail watchdog.

risks.title: Dependencies vanish on every restart (g4f, pytest, web3, cryptography, eth_account)
risks.mitigation: requirements.txt + scripts/bootstrap-pod.sh reinstall everything under /workspace in one command.

risks.title: The datacenter IP is blocked (403 / captcha)
risks.mitigation: Do not fight 403/captcha. Use official APIs (YouTube Data API, FB Graph) and the signed-in cloud desktop for login-only surfaces; fall back to keyless search (ops/websearch.py).

risks.title: The sandbox token scope is narrow (403 on write)
risks.mitigation: Write routes are explicit: the vault workflow token for pushes, the app token via scripts/use-app-token.sh, PC1 as the fallback. Never assume the ambient token can write.

risks.title: Automations get no secret injection; secrets must never land in the repo or a remote URL
risks.mitigation: Secrets live in OpenHands secrets and the KV vault (never packed, .pem excluded). The git remote is left without a token between sessions.

risks.title: Two jobs committing at once collide (push race)
risks.mitigation: Do not `git pull --rebase` on a branch another job commits to; use the GitHub Contents API for concurrent writes, and allowlist mutable state files in .gitignore so `git add` does not drop them.

risks.title: Registry drift happens silently
risks.mitigation: Reconcile the canonical registry against the live scope; the registry is validated before it is trusted.

risks.title: Disk / inode exhaustion
risks.mitigation: Build artefacts are gitignored; /tmp is not relied on for durable work; the vault caps each value at 65536 bytes.
